theorem streaming (n : Nat) :
  cost (euler n) ≤ 2 * 2 ^ n ∧
    run (euler n) (rootHead n) = some (rootHead n) ∧
      leafVisits (euler n) (rootHead n) = some (leftToRightLeaves n) ∧
        (leftToRightLeaves n).length = 2 ^ n
name: Adic.Dyadic.streaming

statement:
theorem random_access {n : Nat} (p : Path n) :
  ∃ final,
    run (descend p) (rootHead n) = some final ∧
      leafPosition final = some p.toList ∧ cost (descend p) = n
name: Adic.Dyadic.random_access

theorem movement_cost_lower_bound {n : Nat} (word : Word)
  (source target : Head n) (hrun : run word source = some target) :
  directedDistance source target ≤ cost word
name: Adic.Dyadic.movement_cost_lower_bound

statement:
theorem movement_cost_realizable {n : Nat} (source target : Head n) :
  ∃ word,
    run word source = some target ∧ cost word = directedDistance source target
name: Adic.Dyadic.movement_cost_realizable

statement:
theorem random_access_optimal {n : Nat} (p : Path n) (word : Word)
  (final : Head n) (hrun : run word (rootHead n) = some final)
  (hleaf : leafPosition final = some p.toList) : n ≤ cost word
name: Adic.Dyadic.random_access_optimal

theorem disjoint_subtree_commute {n k : Nat} (config : ActionConfig n k)
  (left right : AddressedOp k) (leftHead rightHead : Fin k)
  (leftRegion rightRegion : List Bool) (hleftHead : left.head = leftHead)
  (hrightHead : right.head = rightHead) (hheads : leftHead ≠ rightHead)
  (hdisjoint : PrefixIncomparable leftRegion rightRegion)
  (hinvariant :
    RegionsInvariant config leftHead rightHead leftRegion rightRegion) :
  runActions [left, right] config = runActions [right, left] config ∧
    actionCost [left, right] = actionCost [right, left]
name: Adic.Dyadic.disjoint_subtree_commute

statement:
theorem disjoint_subtree_interleaving {k n : Nat}
  {left right first second : ActionWord k} (leftHead rightHead : Fin k)
  (leftRegion rightRegion : List Bool) (hheads : leftHead ≠ rightHead)
  (hdisjoint : PrefixIncomparable leftRegion rightRegion)
  (hleft : ConfinedWord left leftHead leftRegion)
  (hright : ConfinedWord right rightHead rightRegion)
  (hfirst : Interleaving left right first)
  (hsecond : Interleaving left right second) (config : ActionConfig n k)
  (hinvariant :
    RegionsInvariant config leftHead rightHead leftRegion rightRegion) :
  runActions first config = runActions second config ∧
    actionCost first = actionCost second
name: Adic.Dyadic.disjoint_subtree_interleaving

theorem zipWord_correct {n : Nat} (a b : Tree n) (output : Tree (n + 1)) :
  runActions (zipWord n a b) (zipStart a b output) =
    some (zipStart a b (interleave n a b))
name: Adic.Dyadic.zipWord_correct

statement:
theorem zipWord_cost {n : Nat} (a b : Tree n) :
  actionCost (zipWord n a b) = zipCost n
name: Adic.Dyadic.zipWord_cost

statement:
theorem zipWord_shape_independent {n : Nat} (a b a' b' : Tree n) :
  actionShape (zipWord n a b) = actionShape (zipWord n a' b')

statement:
theorem copyWord_correct {n : Nat} (source destination : Tree n) :
  runActions (copyWord n source) (copyStart source destination) =
    some (copyStart source source)
name: Adic.Dyadic.copyWord_correct

statement:
theorem doublingCopyTotal_linear_bound (c : Nat) :
  doublingCopyTotal c ≤ 12 * 2 ^ c
name: Adic.Dyadic.doublingCopyTotal_linear_bound

theorem ram_program_simulation {s v : Nat} (program : RamProgram s)
  (config : RamConfig s v) :
  ∃ scratch',
    runActions (compileProgram program config) (simulatorStart config) =
        some (encodedConfig (runRam program config) scratch') ∧
      ScratchRepresents (runRam program config) scratch' ∧
        actionCost (compileProgram program config) ≤
          6 * ramCost program * (s + 2 ^ v)
name: Adic.Dyadic.ram_program_simulation

theorem distCost_append {k : Nat} (dists : Dists k)
  (first second : ActionWord k) :
  distCost dists (first ++ second) =
    distCost dists first + distCost dists second
name: Adic.Dyadic.distCost_append

statement:
theorem distCost_zero {k : Nat} (word : ActionWord k) :
  distCost (fun x => 0) word = actionCost word
name: Adic.Dyadic.distCost_zero

statement:
theorem kraft_iff_mounting {k : Nat} (dists : Dists k) :
  KraftOk dists ↔
    ∃ paths,
      (∀ (head : Fin k), (paths head).length = dists head) ∧
        Function.Injective paths ∧
          ∀ {left right : Fin k},
            left ≠ right → PrefixIncomparable (paths left) (paths right)
name: Adic.Dyadic.kraft_iff_mounting

statement:
theorem dist_zipWord {n : Nat} (dists : Dists 3) (a b : Tree n) :
  distCost dists (zipWord n a b) = distZipCost dists n
name: Adic.Dyadic.dist_zipWord

statement:
theorem distZipCost_closed (dists : Dists 3) (n : Nat) :
  distZipCost dists n =
    (6 + dists inputAHead + dists inputBHead + 4 * dists outputHead) * 2 ^ n +
      (6 + 2 * (dists inputAHead + dists inputBHead + dists outputHead)) *
        (2 ^ n - 1)
name: Adic.Dyadic.distZipCost_closed

statement:
theorem dist_zipWord_linear_bound {n : Nat} (dists : Dists 3)
  (a b : Tree n) :
  distCost dists (zipWord n a b) ≤ (1 + maxDist dists) * 12 * 2 ^ n
name: Adic.Dyadic.dist_zipWord_linear_bound

theorem ram_action_simulation {k n : Nat} :
  ∃ c,
    ∀ (action : AddressedOp k) (config next : ActionConfig n k),
      actionStep action config = some next →
        ∃ target,
          runRegisterRam (actionRamProgram n action)
                (registerEncode action.head config) =
              some target ∧
            RegisterRep next target ∧
              registerRamCost (actionRamProgram n action) ≤ c
name: Adic.Dyadic.ram_action_simulation

theorem touchCost_counts {k : Nat} (dists : Dists k)
  (touches : List (Fin k)) :
  touchCost dists touches =
    touches.length + finSum fun head => touchCount touches head * dists head
name: Adic.Dyadic.touchCost_counts

statement:
theorem distCost_eq_touchCost {k : Nat} (dists : Dists k)
  (word : ActionWord k) :
  distCost dists word = touchCost dists (acquisitionTouches word)
name: Adic.Dyadic.distCost_eq_touchCost

theorem empiricalDists_kraft {k : Nat} (touches : List (Fin k))
  (hnonempty : 0 < touches.length)
  (hpositive : ∀ (head : Fin k), 0 < touchCount touches head) :
  KraftOk (empiricalDists touches)
name: Adic.Dyadic.empiricalDists_kraft

statement:
theorem touchCost_empirical_exact {k : Nat} (touches : List (Fin k)) :
  touchCost (empiricalDists touches) touches =
    touches.length +
      finSum fun head =>
        touchCount touches head *
          inverseFrequencyDist touches.length (touchCount touches head)
name: Adic.Dyadic.touchCost_empirical_exact

statement:
theorem touchCost_empirical_entropy_bound {k : Nat} (touches : List (Fin k))
  (hnonempty : 0 < touches.length)
  (hpositive : ∀ (head : Fin k), 0 < touchCount touches head) :
  touchCost (empiricalDists touches) touches ≤
    empiricalFloorLogTotal touches + 2 * touches.length
name: Adic.Dyadic.touchCost_empirical_entropy_bound

statement:
theorem kraft_logDeficit_bound {k : Nat} (total : Nat)
  (counts : Fin k → Nat) (dists : Dists k) (hKraft : KraftOk dists) :
  (finSum fun head => counts head * ((total / counts head).log2 - dists head)) ≤
    total
name: Adic.Dyadic.kraft_logDeficit_bound

statement:
theorem discrete_gibbs_log_sum {k : Nat} (total : Nat)
  (counts : Fin k → Nat) (dists : Dists k) (htotal : finSum counts = total)
  (hKraft : KraftOk dists) :
  floorLogTotal total counts ≤ distCountTotal counts dists + total
name: Adic.Dyadic.discrete_gibbs_log_sum

statement:
theorem touchCost_entropy_lower {k : Nat} (dists : Dists k)
  (touches : List (Fin k)) (hKraft : KraftOk dists) :
  touches.length + empiricalFloorLogTotal touches ≤
    touchCost dists touches + touches.length
name: Adic.Dyadic.touchCost_entropy_lower

statement:
theorem empiricalFloorLogTotal_le_touchCost {k : Nat} (dists : Dists k)
  (touches : List (Fin k)) (hKraft : KraftOk dists) :
  empiricalFloorLogTotal touches ≤ touchCost dists touches
name: Adic.Dyadic.empiricalFloorLogTotal_le_touchCost

theorem ram_program_reverse_simulation {k n : Nat} :
  ∃ c,
    ∀ (word : ActionWord k) (source final : ActionConfig n k)
      (start : RegisterRamConfig n k),
      RegisterRep source start →
        runActions word source = some final →
          ∃ target,
            runRegisterRam (compileActionWord n word) start = some target ∧
              RegisterRep final target ∧
                registerRamCost (compileActionWord n word) ≤
                  c * (actionCost word + freeUpCount word)
name: Adic.Dyadic.ram_program_reverse_simulation
